assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: PROV-KEY-003 (Dazhongsi AI industry cluster) is carried over unchanged from the organizer's provisional geometry. Its recalculated area matches the announced 72.0 ha, but its centroid (39.946920 N, 116.348500 E) sits near Beijing North Station / Xizhimen rather than Dazhongsi. This package does not carry an OSM extract or any measured distance for this offset; the offset was raised in issue #1029 and confirmed by the maintainers, who clarified in #1036 that the placeholder rectangles are ordered north-to-south by announced area only and are not yet anchored to stations or roads.
assumptions.impact: All spatial conclusions for this area hold as the Market Floor production station, not as the area around Dazhongsi station. The station-integration and four-quadrant pedestrian connectivity tasks are deliberately not drawn on this provisional geometry. This package does not translate the geometry on its own; once official key-area polygons are released, the geometry, metrics and drawings for this area must be regenerated.
